title: The people move to the appointed place
summary: In the latter end of the seventeenth year, Lachoneus’s proclamation has gone throughout the land. People march by thousands with horses, chariots, animals, grain, and possessions to the appointed gathering area. Many thousands called Nephites gather in the land southward, where Lachoneus caused them to gather because of the great curse upon the land northward.
locations: the land between Zarahemla and Bountiful, extending to the line between Bountiful and Desolation

explicit_facts.text: In the latter end of the seventeenth year, the proclamation of Lachoneus had gone forth throughout the land.

People took horses, chariots, cattle, flocks, herds, grain, and their substance and marched by thousands and tens of thousands to the appointed gathering place to defend themselves against their enemies.
The appointed land was Zarahemla and the land between Zarahemla and Bountiful, to the line between Bountiful and Desolation.
Many thousands called Nephites gathered in this land. Lachoneus caused them to gather in the land southward because of the great curse upon the land northward.
